use_case_name: Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas

claims.content: C2 JU
The J3.0 Reference Point, J3.1 Emergency Point, and the J3.5 Land (Ground) Point/Track messages are used to report points.
Each point, line, or area reported on the interface shall be assigned a TN(s) by the reporting JU.
Certain reference points and areas may be slaved in a constant position in relation to a Related TN.

The C2 JU needs to exchange tactical information about geographic references, report the existence of an emergency condition that requires search and rescue efforts, or report the location of fixed ground units or objects.

trigger.raw_text: The C2 JU needs to exchange tactical information about geographic references, report the existence of an emergency condition that requires search and rescue efforts, or report the location of fixed ground units or objects.

claims.content: The C2 JU selects the appropriate message type: J3.0 for Reference Points, J3.1 for Emergency Points, or J3.5 for Land (Ground) Points/Tracks.
The C2 JU assigns a Track Number (TN) to the point, line, or area reported on the interface.
The C2 JU reports the position using geodetic latitude/longitude values.
If required, the C2 JU reports the altitude/elevation of the point, line, or area using J3.0 or J3.5 messages.
The C2 JU reports the time associated with the point, line, or area in hours/minutes, with the meaning defined by the Time Function field.
To define lines (e.g., PRAs, roads), areas (e.g., search areas, exercise areas), or volumes (e.g., corridors), the C2 JU uses the J3.0 message capabilities.
To define a circle or ellipse about a ground point, the C2 JU uses the J3.5 message capability.
To define Corridors or Low Level Transit Routes (LLTR), the C2 JU uses Point Type value 4 with Line and Point Amplification value 3 for Corridors or value 6 for LLTRs.
For Corridors and LLTRs, the C2 JU reports width in the Area Major Axis, 4 field in the J3.0C5 word and sets all other J3.0C5 fields to No Statement.
To define Electronic Warfare Areas of Probability (EW AOPs), the C2 JU uses the J3.71/J3.7C1/J3.7C2 word sequence.
To slave a point or area to a Related TN, the C2 JU sets the Slaved Indicator to value 1 and establishes the position as Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 from the Related TN.
For slaved points or areas, the C2 JU uses the J3.0C4 word to indicate whether slaving is on a true or relative bearing.
Each point, line, or area reported on the interface is assigned a TN(s) by the reporting JU.
The position is reported using geodetic latitude/longitude values.
The time associated with the reported point, line, or area is reported in hours/minutes.
If the point or area is slaved, the position is established as Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 from the Related TN.
If the point is a fixed land (ground) IU that has reverted to an inactive status, the system retains the TN and last reported position.
